question: Who among the following has been credited with developing a notation system for Indian classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande** is credited with developing a notation system for Indian classical music.
 
• Bhatkhande's notation system is one of the most widely used systems to transcribe Indian classical music.
 
• He traveled extensively across India to collect, document, and classify the compositions of Indian classical music.
 
• His work laid the foundation for modern music education in India, and he established several music colleges and institutions.
 
• Bhatkhande's efforts were instrumental in making Indian classical music more accessible and standardized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kumar Gandharva** was a renowned Hindustani classical singer known for his unique style and innovative approach.
 
• **Bal Gandharva** was a famous Marathi singer and stage actor, known for his contributions to Marathi theatre.
 
• **Bhimsen Joshi** was an eminent Indian vocalist from the Kirana Gharana, celebrated for his khayal singing.
 
• Bhatkhande's work in musicology includes the publication of several books that systematized the teaching and performance of Indian classical music.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Father of Modern Hindustani Music" due to his pioneering contributions.
